program.objective: Demonstrate the supervisor running two dependent tasks through the real Claude Code runtime with no user prompt between them.

tasks.title: Create the marker file
tasks.instruction:
Create a file named exactly hello.txt in the current working directory whose entire content is the single line: ATLAS-STEP-A-DONE
Do not create or modify any other file. When the file exists, stop.

tasks.title: Derive the second file from the first
tasks.instruction:
Read the file hello.txt in the current working directory. Create a file named exactly world.txt whose entire content is the single line: DERIVED-FROM:<contents of hello.txt, trimmed>
For example if hello.txt contains ATLAS-STEP-A-DONE then world.txt must contain DERIVED-FROM:ATLAS-STEP-A-DONE
Do not create or modify any other file. When the file exists, stop.

acceptance.description: world.txt records that it was derived from step-a's output

implementer.description: Real Claude Code worker, edit-capable, no network tools.
